name: Get Golden Gate Assembly Protocol
description: Return a customized protocol for Golden Gate assembly based on the number of inserts and specific DNA sequences.
detailed_description: Return a customized protocol for Golden Gate assembly based on the number of inserts and specific DNA sequences.
when_to_use: When you need get golden gate assembly protocol analysis

parameters.enzyme_name: [Required] Type IIS restriction enzyme to be used (str)
parameters.vector_length: [Required] Length of the destination vector in bp (int)
parameters.num_inserts: [Optional] Number of inserts to be assembled (default: 1)
parameters.vector_amount_ng: [Optional] Amount of vector to use in ng (default: 75.0)
parameters.insert_lengths: [Optional] List of insert lengths in bp
parameters.is_library_prep: [Optional] Whether this is for library preparation (default: False)
